options.name: application
options.description: Set the pool application on the pool.

options.name: erasure_profile
options.description: When pool_type = 'erasure', set the erasure profile of the pool

options.name: expected_num_objects
options.description: Set the expected_num_objects parameter of the pool.

options.name: min_size
options.description: set the min_size parameter of the pool. default to `osd_pool_default_min_size` (ceph)

options.name: pg_autoscale_mode
options.description: set the pg autoscaler on the pool.

options.name: pg_num
options.description: set the pg_num of the pool. default to `osd_pool_default_pg_num` (ceph)

options.name: pgp_num
options.description: set the pgp_num of the pool. default to `osd_pool_default_pgp_num` (ceph)

options.name: pool_type
options.description: set the pool type, either 'replicated' or 'erasure'

options.name: rule_name
options.description: Set the crush rule name assigned to the pool. default 'replicated_rule' when pool_type is 'erasure' else None

options.name: size
options.description: set the replica size of the pool.

options.name: state
options.description: If 'present' is used, the module creates a pool if it doesn't exist or update it if it already exists. If 'absent' is used, the module will simply delete the pool. If 'list' is used, the module will return all details about the existing pools. (json formatted).

options.name: target_size_ratio
options.description: set the target_size_ratio on the pool
